rules.name: Lateral Movement: RDP Followed by Credential Access
rules.description: Correlation rule detecting rdp followed by credential access
rules.query: CommonSecurityLog| where DestinationIP !startswith "10." and SourceIP !startswith "10."| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), SourceIP, DestinationIP | where count_ > 3 // AZ-LAT-0700

rules.name: Lateral Movement: SSH Followed by Privilege Escalation
rules.description: Correlation rule detecting ssh followed by privilege escalation
rules.query: CommonSecurityLog| where DestinationIP !startswith "10." and SourceIP !startswith "10."| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), SourceIP, DestinationIP | where count_ > 3 // AZ-LAT-0701

rules.name: Lateral Movement: SMB Share Access Followed by File Encryption

rules.name: Lateral Movement: WMI Remote Execution Followed by Persistence
rules.description: Correlation rule detecting wmi remote execution followed by persistence
rules.query: AuditLogs | where OperationName contains "lateral" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), InitiatedBy | where count_ > 3 // AZ-LAT-0703

rules.name: Lateral Movement: PsExec Followed by Discovery
rules.description: Correlation rule detecting psexec followed by discovery
rules.query: CommonSecurityLog| where DestinationIP !startswith "10." and SourceIP !startswith "10."| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), SourceIP, DestinationIP | where count_ > 3 // AZ-LAT-0704

rules.name: Lateral Movement: PowerShell Remoting Followed by Credential Dumping
rules.description: Correlation rule detecting powershell remoting followed by credential dumping
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "lateral" or CommandLine contains "movement" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 3 // AZ-LAT-0705

rules.name: Lateral Movement: WinRM Followed by Defense Evasion
rules.description: Correlation rule detecting winrm followed by defense evasion
rules.query: CommonSecurityLog| where DestinationIP !startswith "10." and SourceIP !startswith "10."| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), SourceIP, DestinationIP | where count_ > 3 // AZ-LAT-0706

rules.name: Lateral Movement: Kerberoasting Followed by Lateral Movement
rules.description: Correlation rule detecting kerberoasting followed by lateral movement
rules.query: SigninLogs | where UserPrincipalName contains "lateral" or IPAddress !startswith "10." | where ResultType == "50126" or ResultType == "50057" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), UserPrincipalName, IPAddress | where count_ > 3 // AZ-LAT-0707

rules.name: Lateral Movement: DCSync Attack Chain
rules.description: Correlation rule detecting dcsync attack chain

rules.name: Lateral Movement: Pass-the-Hash Detection
rules.query: SigninLogs | where UserPrincipalName contains "lateral" or IPAddress !startswith "10." | where ResultType == "50126" or ResultType == "50057" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), UserPrincipalName, IPAddress | where count_ > 3 // AZ-LAT-0709
